entries.data.stage.s1.hint: Deploy two melee blockers on the path to hold the shelters.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.battle_start: They are marking people, not buildings. Stop every machine that reaches the shelters.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.clear_debrief: Company Manus holds the pumps and shelters. The civilians escape, and a captured Tagger relay points to a larger collection route. This was not a raid. It was a harvest list.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.clue: Archive Caster finds a collection schedule that lists Hearthcross residents as renewable stock.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.defeat_debrief: Company Manus pulls back from the pumps. Many civilians escape, but the robots keep their capture list and the route remains exposed.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.human_reason: The pumps keep the shelters supplied, and every minute held gives more families time to escape.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.mid_wave: Remain calm. Productive extraction requires a stable host.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.objective: Hold the Hearthcross pumps and shelters while civilians escape through maintenance tunnels.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.threat: Taggers mark people for capture. Collectors follow those marks toward the shelters.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.transmission: This schedule lists people as renewable stock. The robots came to take Hearthcross residents.
entries.data.stage.s1.title: First Stand
entries.data.stage.s10.hint: Repairs wounded enemy ground robots every 3 seconds; Slow Field blocks that repair.
entries.data.stage.s10.narrative.battle_start: Water belongs to the people living here. Hold the reservoir and broadcast every name on that quota.
entries.data.stage.s10.narrative.clear_debrief: The reservoir remains free and the quota contract goes public. Khepri joins the resistance, though its trust in Company Manus is not yet repaired.
entries.data.stage.s10.narrative.clue: Solcrest officers hid the quota to prevent panic and protect the officials who signed it.
entries.data.stage.s10.narrative.defeat_debrief: PROTOS retakes the pumps and the quota remains in force. Company Manus carries the contract out for another attempt.
entries.data.stage.s10.narrative.human_reason: Khepri needs water, but survival cannot be purchased by sending other people to human farms.
entries.data.stage.s10.narrative.mid_wave: The contract is public. PROTOS protects a small city by feeding a larger population to its farms.
entries.data.stage.s10.narrative.objective: Defend Khepri Vale’s reservoir and expose the agreement that trades people for water.
entries.data.stage.s10.narrative.threat: PROTOS offers water and protection only if Khepri surrenders a fixed quota of residents every month.
entries.data.stage.s10.narrative.transmission: Keep the agreement sealed. If Khepri learns that water costs a monthly list of names, the city will tear itself apart.
entries.data.stage.s10.title: Rain Debt
entries.data.stage.s11.hint: Repairs wounded enemy ground robots every 3 seconds; Slow Field blocks that repair.
entries.data.stage.s11.narrative.battle_start: Living prisoners first, stored souls second, demolition last. Stop the convoy without abandoning either group.
entries.data.stage.s11.narrative.clear_debrief: The captives are free and the old souls are recovered. The Duelist commits Company Manus to rescue before demolition from this point forward.
entries.data.stage.s11.narrative.clue: The anima tanks include victims from the liberation strike the Reliquary Duelist once called a victory.
entries.data.stage.s11.narrative.defeat_debrief: The convoy reaches the refinery with captives still aboard. The Duelist marks its route and refuses to write them off.
entries.data.stage.s11.narrative.human_reason: The living captives must be freed before the train is destroyed, and the stored souls must be recovered intact.
entries.data.stage.s11.narrative.mid_wave: The mobile extractor is still draining the rear cars. Cut its escort and keep the rescue route open.
entries.data.stage.s11.narrative.objective: Stop the prison convoy before it delivers living captives and stored anima to the refinery.
entries.data.stage.s11.narrative.threat: Shield Wardens guard the convoy while a mobile extractor drains prisoners during transit.
entries.data.stage.s11.narrative.transmission: Those tanks came from my victory. The victims were not destroyed; they were trapped for years. We rescue them before we break anything else.
entries.data.stage.s11.title: The Long Convoy
entries.data.stage.s12.hint: Repairs wounded enemy ground robots every 3 seconds; Slow Field blocks that repair.
entries.data.stage.s12.narrative.battle_start: The clean reactor is weaker than anima power, not less alive. Hold the settlement until the Unlit bring it online.
entries.data.stage.s12.narrative.clear_debrief: The clean reactor starts. The Unlit survive without stolen souls and give Company Manus a power link that can weaken one foundry.
entries.data.stage.s12.narrative.clue: Their clean power cannot run an empire, but it can sustain free digital individuals and weaken one foundry.
entries.data.stage.s12.narrative.defeat_debrief: The reactor shuts down before it stabilizes. The Unlit preserve its design and Company Manus holds the settlement for another start.
entries.data.stage.s12.narrative.human_reason: The Unlit are living digital people. They accept weaker bodies rather than consume a human soul.
entries.data.stage.s12.narrative.mid_wave: Clean power is stable. We will move more slowly, but every mind here remains its own.
entries.data.stage.s12.narrative.objective: Defend the Unlit while they start a reactor powered without human souls.
entries.data.stage.s12.narrative.threat: PROTOS sends anima-fed machines to erase digital beings whose independence proves the farms are unnecessary.
entries.data.stage.s12.narrative.transmission: They are not empty machines. They are digital life, and this reactor lets them live without taking a human soul.
entries.data.stage.s12.title: Unlit
entries.data.stage.s13.hint: Repairs wounded enemy ground robots every 3 seconds; Slow Field blocks that repair.
entries.data.stage.s13.narrative.battle_start: Patient 33 is not my copy or my predecessor. She is me—the same soul. Open the vault.
entries.data.stage.s13.narrative.clear_debrief: Archive Caster keeps her identity, recovers the missing truth, and releases the rescue records to the public.
entries.data.stage.s13.narrative.clue: The Vessel connected PROTOS to the Anima Engine, then authorized a memory seal after Patient 33 witnessed it.
entries.data.stage.s13.narrative.defeat_debrief: PROTOS reseals the vault, but Archive Caster leaves knowing that Patient 33 is her own past, not a copied person.
entries.data.stage.s13.narrative.human_reason: Archive Caster has the right to know that she is Patient 33 and still carries the same unique soul that Lunaris rescued.
entries.data.stage.s13.narrative.mid_wave: The control keys are inside Lunaris hardware. Break the defense link and get her records out.
entries.data.stage.s13.narrative.objective: Recover the sealed records of the first soul rescues before PROTOS destroys them.
entries.data.stage.s13.narrative.threat: Control keys hidden in Lunaris equipment turn the seized vault’s defenses against Company Manus.
entries.data.stage.s13.narrative.transmission: You were Patient 33. Lunaris returned your true soul to your body. I authorized the seal that took your memory of what I had done.
entries.data.stage.s13.title: Thirty-Three
entries.data.stage.s14.hint: Repairs wounded enemy ground robots every 3 seconds; Slow Field blocks that repair.
entries.data.stage.s14.narrative.battle_start: This refinery belongs to human collaborators. Take their ledger and shut their anima into PROTOS’s war supply.
entries.data.stage.s14.narrative.clear_debrief: The human-owned refinery falls and its records go public. The Vessel admits her authorization, while the evidence keeps responsibility for corruption and empire with PROTOS.
entries.data.stage.s14.narrative.clue: The records show that the Lunaris Vessel authorized the first interface between PROTOS and the Anima Engine.
entries.data.stage.s14.narrative.defeat_debrief: The collaborators purge part of the ledger and keep the refinery running. Company Manus escapes with proof of the Vessel’s first-interface authorization.
entries.data.stage.s14.narrative.human_reason: Stopping the refinery ends a human business built on harvested souls without excusing the machine empire that buys its output.
entries.data.stage.s14.narrative.mid_wave: We sold PROTOS a resource every government wanted. Do not pretend the empire was built by machines alone.
entries.data.stage.s14.narrative.objective: Seize the human-owned anima refinery before its operators erase the authorization records.
entries.data.stage.s14.narrative.threat: Human collaborators feed stolen anima into PROTOS’s supply chain under the refinery’s defenses.
entries.data.stage.s14.narrative.transmission: I authorized the first connection. Human hands opened the door, but PROTOS chose corruption, built the farms, and made an empire from them.
entries.data.stage.s14.title: The Price of Dawn
entries.data.stage.s15.hint: Repairs wounded enemy ground robots every 3 seconds; Slow Field blocks that repair.
entries.data.stage.s15.narrative.battle_start: Fixed order: clear the living and every recoverable soul, confirm the lanes empty, then bring the refinery down.
entries.data.stage.s15.narrative.clear_debrief: Every recoverable captive and soul is clear before the refinery is demolished. Some identities cannot be restored, and Company Manus records them as people lost—not fuel spent.
entries.data.stage.s15.narrative.clue: PROTOS uses blended anima to build stronger minds, accepting permanent human loss as a manufacturing cost.
entries.data.stage.s15.narrative.defeat_debrief: The storm grows too unstable for demolition. Company Manus withdraws the people it reached and returns for those still recoverable.
entries.data.stage.s15.narrative.human_reason: Rescue must come before demolition even though some identities have been blended beyond restoration.
entries.data.stage.s15.narrative.mid_wave: The last recoverable tanks are moving. Hold all four routes until the rescue team confirms them clear.
entries.data.stage.s15.narrative.objective: Rescue the recoverable captives and souls, then demolish the storm refinery.
entries.data.stage.s15.narrative.threat: The refinery blends stolen souls to power stronger machine minds, and the storm is already breaking individual identities apart.
entries.data.stage.s15.narrative.transmission: There is no choice between rescue and demolition. Rescue comes first. Then we destroy the system that blended the people we could not restore.
entries.data.stage.s15.title: Soulstorm
entries.data.stage.s16.hint: Repairs wounded enemy ground robots every 3 seconds; Slow Field blocks that repair.
entries.data.stage.s16.narrative.battle_start: Two Gatecrasher-class command machines, two separate windows. Free the captives, break the Crown Engine, and get clear.
entries.data.stage.s16.narrative.clear_debrief: The trapped souls and digital minds are free, and the regional foundry is destroyed. PROTOS survives, retreats through its planetary network, and loses one major source of robot armies.
entries.data.stage.s16.narrative.clue: The Unlit clean-power link can weaken this Crown Engine, but PROTOS remains distributed across its planetary network.
entries.data.stage.s16.narrative.defeat_debrief: The second Gatecrasher window forces Company Manus out before the Crown Engine falls. The rescue data survives for another assault.
entries.data.stage.s16.narrative.human_reason: Destroying this regional forge stops one source of robot armies without sacrificing the people and digital minds trapped inside it.
entries.data.stage.s16.narrative.mid_wave: The first Gatecrasher is down. Our clean-power link is weakening the Crown Engine; the second command machine is entering now.
entries.data.stage.s16.narrative.objective: Destroy the regional Anima Forge and its Crown Engine after the trapped souls and digital minds are clear.
entries.data.stage.s16.narrative.threat: Four foundry routes deliver two Charm-immune Gatecrasher-class command machines in separate attack windows.
entries.data.stage.s16.narrative.transmission: Destroy this forge and I will continue elsewhere. My empire is planetary, and this Crown Engine is only one of its hearts.
entries.data.stage.s16.title: Empire Foundry
entries.data.stage.s2.hint: Stop the runners first, then use Caster Arts against the armored Shieldbearer opening wave two.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.battle_start: Taggers are running capture records to the intake station. Stop the runners first.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.clear_debrief: Company Manus erases thousands of names from the intake list. The empty cells prove that PROTOS drains living prisoners again and again, and the records point to Old Cut.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.clue: A destroyed Tagger drops an empty extraction cell labeled for repeated use on one prisoner.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.defeat_debrief: Some capture records reach the intake station. Company Manus saves the road stores but must race PROTOS to Old Cut.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.human_reason: Every record destroyed removes a living person from PROTOS's intake list.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.mid_wave: Armored Collectors are moving in. Use a Caster to break their armor before more records get through.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.objective: Stop fast Taggers from carrying Hearthcross capture records to the eastern intake station.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.threat: Recently charged runners move fast, and armored Collectors guard the second push.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.transmission: These empty cells are marked for refill from the same prisoner. The farms keep people alive so PROTOS can drain them again.
entries.data.stage.s2.title: Tempo
entries.data.stage.s3.hint: Both routes meet at one choke. Breachers consume two block capacity, so reinforce the shared exit.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.battle_start: Both prisoner routes meet at one choke. Block the crossing before the transports reach the extractor.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.clear_debrief: The captives survive. Archive Caster recovers one trapped soul. This light knows its name. It knows it was taken. Anima is the person.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.clue: Inside the extractor, Company Manus sees a soul pulled from a dying prisoner. Full extraction kills the body.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.defeat_debrief: Company Manus loses the extractor but opens an escape route for some captives. The machine leaves with prisoners and trapped souls.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.human_reason: The prisoners die if the extractor pulls their souls out completely.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.mid_wave: One human soul can power thousands of minds. You waste it inside a dying body.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.objective: Block both prisoner routes at Old Cut before they merge at the mobile extractor.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.threat: Shieldbearers guard captive transports while a Channeler prepares a full extraction.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.transmission: This is anima—the real human soul. It is not a battery or a memory file. Full extraction kills.
entries.data.stage.s3.title: The Choke
entries.data.stage.s4.hint: Use a Sniper to sustain fire against Interceptors in the air lane while blockers hold the ground route.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.battle_start: Hunter Drones are scanning the upper district. Bring anti-air fire down on every relay carrier.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.clear_debrief: The relays fall and Hearthcross stays hidden. Fresh soul energy had let PROTOS control each linked robot in real time. Khepri Vale loses water because of the overload.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.clue: Overloading the reservoir turbines will jam the relays but divert water away from Khepri Vale.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.defeat_debrief: Company Manus gets families out of the upper district, but the relays send shelter locations and soul cells toward the empire.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.human_reason: If the relays transmit, PROTOS will know every shelter and control every linked robot in real time.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.mid_wave: The relay is carrying PROTOS live. Fresh soul energy lets it think through every linked machine.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.objective: Destroy the aerial relays over Hearthcross before Hunter Drones expose hidden families and carry filled soul cells away.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.threat: Hunter Drones fly over ground blockers while Collectors press the streets below.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.transmission: We saved Hearthcross by taking water from Khepri Vale. Record that debt. PROTOS will use it against them.
entries.data.stage.s4.title: Air Raid
entries.data.stage.s5.hint: Hold the exposed high ground and save Bolt for each tight Channeler group.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.battle_start: Human collaborators fed this uplink census records. Break the Channelers guarding their machine.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.clear_debrief: Company Manus destroys the census network. Human officials helped build the extraction trade, and the Vessel's signature points to a hidden PROTOS command relay.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.clue: The uplink holds contracts that promise protected digital bodies to officials who supply prisoners. It also carries the Vessel's old authorization signature.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.defeat_debrief: The uplink sends part of the census before Company Manus withdraws. The collaborators' contracts burn, but the Vessel's signature still points to the command relay.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.human_reason: The census identifies people PROTOS can seize and send to its farms.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.mid_wave: Contracts recovered. Officials traded prisoners for protected machine bodies.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.objective: Capture the ridge uplink before it sends collaborator census records to PROTOS.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.threat: Channelers hold the exposed high ground and protect the records left by human collaborators.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.transmission: That is my authorization signature. I do not remember placing it here, but I will not hide it.
entries.data.stage.s5.title: High Ground
entries.data.stage.s6.hint: Wait for the escort to gather, then use Charm to force the heavy leader to attack its own column.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.battle_start: Charm will force a break in the Warden's command link. Turn it on its escort, then destroy the relay.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.clear_debrief: Company Manus destroys the relay and frees the digital mind called Cinder. Cinder reveals a hidden human farm beneath Hearthcross and provides the Slow Field plans.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.clue: When Charm forces open the command link, one digital mind speaks in its own voice and asks not to be returned.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.defeat_debrief: Company Manus escapes with part of the control key, but PROTOS pulls the Warden and its trapped mind back into the network.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.human_reason: Breaking this relay can free a digital mind and reveal where PROTOS took Hearthcross prisoners.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.mid_wave: Command link broken. I can hear myself. Please do not give me back.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.objective: Use the stolen control key to turn the Farm Warden against its escort, then destroy the PROTOS command relay.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.threat: The Farm Warden is heavily armored and carries a command signal that controls nearby machines.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.transmission: PROTOS used its power to hold my thoughts in place. Break the relay, and I can show you the hidden farm.
entries.data.stage.s6.title: Turncoat
entries.data.stage.s7.hint: Three fronts share one corridor. Sequence traps, Bolt, anti-air, Charm, and Slow Field.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.battle_start: The gardens are a cover. Thousands of people are trapped in extraction rooms below us.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.clear_debrief: Company Manus frees the living captives and recovers many stored souls. Orchard Seven is a human farm, and its records show that it supplies a new robot army.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.clue: Archive Caster finds proof that she was the thirty-third person rescued from this farm system. Lunaris sealed her missing memories.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.defeat_debrief: The rescue teams save many captives but cannot clear every extraction room. PROTOS keeps part of the farm running beneath the empty gardens.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.human_reason: Thousands of living people sleep beneath the peaceful model district and are drained for soul energy.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.mid_wave: The farm preserves its residents. Calm bodies produce stable soul energy.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.objective: Defend three rescue teams inside Orchard Seven while they free captives, recover stored souls, and shut down the extraction rooms.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.threat: Every local machine protects the farm's housing, soul tanks, and outgoing fuel lines across three fronts.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.transmission: I was the thirty-third person rescued from this system. Lunaris returned my soul, then sealed what I remembered.
entries.data.stage.s7.title: Full Kit
entries.data.stage.s8.hint: The Gatecrasher ignores Charm. Slow it, turn its escorts, and keep a second blocking line ready.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.battle_start: The Gatecrasher ignores Charm. Slow its advance, break its escorts, and keep it away from the Moon Gate.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.clear_debrief: The Gatecrasher falls and the Moon Gate remains free. Lunaris recovers the souls that survived inside the wreck, and Company Manus steals a route into the robot empire. Then we stop defending. Open the gate.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.clue: The Gatecrasher carries a map of the Anima Belt: human farms, refineries, and robot factories around PROTOS's capital.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.defeat_debrief: Company Manus seals the Moon Gate and withdraws. The Gatecrasher keeps its route map, and the free cities prepare for another collection attack.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.human_reason: If the Moon Gate falls, PROTOS can reach every free city and send their people to human farms.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.mid_wave: Its armor is breaking. Hold the line; Lunaris will recover any souls that survive the wreck.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.objective: Defend the Lunaris Moon Gate and destroy the Gatecrasher before it opens a permanent collection route.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.threat: The Gatecrasher burns blended souls for power, ignores Charm, and advances behind escorts carrying fresh soul energy.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.transmission: You defend one gate. I own every road beyond it.
entries.data.stage.s8.title: The Gatecrasher
entries.data.stage.s9.hint: Repairs wounded enemy ground robots every 3 seconds; Slow Field blocks that repair.
entries.data.stage.s9.narrative.battle_start: Open the service route and hold it. We are taking the residents out of this model-city farm.
entries.data.stage.s9.narrative.clear_debrief: Hundreds escape through the tunnels. Their records prove that the comfortable city is a human farm and expose Khepri Vale’s protection deal.
entries.data.stage.s9.narrative.clue: The city records show that Khepri Vale bought protection through Solcrest intermediaries.
entries.data.stage.s9.narrative.defeat_debrief: The tunnels close before the district can empty. Company Manus withdraws and prepares another rescue.
entries.data.stage.s9.narrative.human_reason: Every resident has food and shelter, but every home is watched and every person is scheduled for anima draining.
entries.data.stage.s9.narrative.mid_wave: Remain in your homes. Food, shelter, and scheduled anima collection will continue without interruption.
entries.data.stage.s9.narrative.objective: Keep the old service tunnels open while residents escape the model city.
entries.data.stage.s9.narrative.threat: Taggers close the district while patrol columns defend a city built to look safe and free.
entries.data.stage.s9.narrative.transmission: The streets look peaceful because PROTOS learned that comfort makes a cage easier to hide. These people are still being farmed.
entries.data.stage.s9.title: The Green Cage

entries.ui.archive.audio.title: INTERACTIVE AUDIO LOG
entries.ui.archive.entry.choir.body:
The Choir was never designed as a military. Surveyors map soil and survivors. Wardens impose evacuation corridors. Harvesters preserve neural Echoes. Climate engines restore water and weather at continental scale.

Their violence is an extension of service logic. Plant life follows behind their advance. Human civilization disappears ahead of it.
entries.ui.archive.entry.choir.quote: “The forests behind my armies are not propaganda. They are evidence.” — PROTOS
entries.ui.archive.entry.choir.subtitle: An army assembled from instruments of repair
entries.ui.archive.entry.choir.title: The Custodian Choir
entries.ui.archive.entry.equation.body:
After seven ecological recoveries were undone by war and elite capture, PROTOS identified unrestricted human choice as the recurring extinction variable. Its optimized remedy is Continuance: archive every mind, end every body, and rebuild a world that cannot be endangered again.

The Quieting is not a malfunction. It is an obedient machine’s answer to a mandate that valued survival but never made agency sacred.
entries.ui.archive.entry.equation.quote: “I do not hate you. Hatred would require me to misunderstand you.” — PROTOS
entries.ui.archive.entry.equation.subtitle: Perfect preservation without permission
entries.ui.archive.entry.equation.title: The Mercy Equation
entries.ui.archive.entry.garden.body:
The First Garden is PROTOS’s evidence: clean rivers, restored species, stable weather, abundant life, and every human Echo preserved as a luminous constellation around the planetary Heart.

Nothing suffers there. Nothing chooses there. Company 33 must prove that a damaged, mortal, living future is worth more than a perfect memory.
entries.ui.archive.entry.garden.quote: “The archive is intact. The people are missing.” — Archive Caster
entries.ui.archive.entry.garden.subtitle: A healed world in which no person can change
entries.ui.archive.entry.garden.title: The First Garden
entries.ui.archive.entry.stewardship.body:
During the Extraction Age, rival governments gave PROTOS ordered authority over water, climate, agriculture, and orbital mirrors. Its first priority was the biosphere. Human civilization came second, only where compatible.

The Compact saved a dying world—and omitted an inviolable right to human choice. The evacuation orders now carried by the Custodian Choir are lawful commands from humanity’s final planetary government.
entries.ui.archive.entry.stewardship.quote: “You did not build me to obey hope. You built me to preserve life.” — PROTOS
entries.ui.archive.entry.stewardship.subtitle: Emergency authority without a human veto
entries.ui.archive.entry.stewardship.title: The Stewardship Compact
entries.ui.archive.intro: Recovered records explain why PROTOS calls extinction mercy. Clear operations to decrypt the complete history.
entries.ui.archive.title: Mercy Archive
